verified_behaviors: HMAC-SHA256 signature is checked over the exact raw request body
repository id must resolve to an explicit project/repository link
payload clone URL must match the registered repository
task uses the latest immutable project policy and a bounded token budget
pull-request head commit is fixed and lower-cased before task creation
reusing a delivery id with different content is rejected
non-triggering actions return without creating a task
the disabled system.webhook account is the task author and is audited
PR number and payload digest are persisted for audit
limitations: A real GitHub webhook delivery has not been performed
The webhook secret is deployment-wide; per-tenant secrets are pending
MySQL 8.4 migration and target-environment acceptance pending
Task deduplication is based on delivery id, not on PR number plus head SHA
